title: Clients ask me, 01/04
content: Clients ask me, 01/04 . “Why does illustration cost more than stock?” . Because stock is made for everyone, including your competitor. Illustration is made for your brand, and only you own it. . What moves the price: detail, style, where it’s used, how many formats, and how fast you need it. . author: Still Becoming Her
title: Looking for advice and a creative partner! 📚🎨
content: Looking for advice and a creative partner! 📚🎨 Hi everyone! I’ve written a children’s storybook that I imagine becoming the first book in a series. I already have ideas for several more adventures, and I would really love to bring this project to life. I’ve approached a few publishers, but so far the offers have mainly been hybrid publishing agreements. I completely understand that publishing involves costs, but unfortunately, I simply don’t have the financial resources to pay for such a deal upfront. I’m starting to think that self-publishing might be my best option. I’d rather take the first steps myself, learn along the way, handle the printing and marketing, and finally get my book out there than let the project sit unfinished. I’m also looking for an illustrator! 🎨 The book is aimed at children aged approximately 2–6 years. The illustrations don’t need to be complicated. You don’t have to be a professional illustrator! You can be a complete beginner, an art student, or simply someone who loves drawing and would enjoy seeing their artwork published in a children’s book. At the moment, I cannot afford to pay upfront, but I would be happy to agree on payment after the book is published and starts generating sales. I’m open to discussing a fair arrangement that works for both sides. I’d also love to hear from anyone who has experience with self-publishing children’s books, especially regarding printing, distribution and marketing. If you have any advice, recommendations, or would simply like to explore the possibility of working together, I’d love to hear from you! Thank you! ❤️ Little example with AI, what style i am looking for.
